name: Gypsy Water
description: A fresh, piney opening of citrus and juniper that softens into creamy sandalwood and a soft vanilla glow. Woody, airy and easy to wear, with a whisper of incense smoke.
source_note: Notes and levels from Byredo's own product page (checked Nov 2026).

name: Philosykos
heart: Fig Leaf; Fig Tree Sap; Fig Wood; Black Pepper
description: A walk through a sunny fig grove: green, milky fig leaves and sap over dry, peppery wood. Fresh and summery rather than sweet.
source_note: Notes from Diptyque's product page, which lists them without top/heart/base levels (checked Nov 2026).

name: Santal 33
heart: Cardamom; Iris; Violet; Sandalwood; Cedar; Leather; Musk
description: A smoky, creamy sandalwood with a dry, leathery edge and a hint of spice. Unisex and instantly recognisable.
source_note: Notes from Le Labo's product pages, which don't split them into levels (checked Nov 2026).

name: Ganymede
description: A bright, almost metallic opening of mandarin and saffron that settles into a soft, suede-like skin scent. It smells cool and mineral, like warm stone after rain, with a gentle floral heart of violet and osmanthus.
source_note: Levels come from retailer listings, which disagree on the base. The brand's own page lists mandarin, osmanthus, immortelle, akigalawood and a leather accord, without levels (checked Nov 2026).
